config.notes: Iona Columba College (iona.edu.au, Sydney). Every read course is bound to the central fees page (/fees/), not a course page. The page prints 'Tuition Fees The tuition fees below apply to students commencing their course in 2026 ... Total tuition fee' as a table (National code, course name, CRICOS code, total), read per course with {code} for review only into location (for example 117093G $6,240). These are whole-course totals with no duration and no international label (the page refers to a 'domestic and international course brochure'), and they differ from the catalogue's international tuition (117093G page $6,240 against catalogue $6,800), so no fee pattern is written and the fee is held (lesson 8). No IELTS, intakes or delivery on stored pages. 099651B is bound to /tuition_fees/ (identity mismatch). The course pages need finding (Layer 2) before any rebind.
